svg.aria-label: FloodSet consensus: In f + 1 synchronous rounds everybody ends up with the same set of values.. round 1: my set of known values; their sets come back, union them; round 2 … f + 1: the union again; after f + 1 rounds: decide min of the set. With at most f crashes, one of the f + 1 rounds is clean, and a clean round makes every set equal.
